title: MetaCloud workspace stack
description: One YAML file defines one infrastructure stack (Terramate/Terragrunt/MetaCloud driver).

source.description: Terraform module source path or registry address.

version.description: Module version constraint. Required for registry/remote sources; omit for local relative paths (./, ../, /).

variables.description: Module input variables. Values may use ${linked-workspace.output} references.

linked_workspaces.description: Relative paths to upstream stacks (without .yaml suffix).

terraform_backend.description: Optional per-stack backend override. Shared settings come from metacloud.yaml.

name.description: Backend type (http, s3, local, …). Usually omitted when set in metacloud.yaml.

configs.description: Backend config. Omit state_key to use the auto-generated stack slug from the YAML path; set state_key only for legacy GitLab/S3 state names.

state_key.description: Legacy GitLab/S3 state name override. Defaults to the Terramate stack slug derived from the YAML path.
